name: Zachary Routsong
tagline: Future engineer. Photographer. Top of his class at Valwood School.

intro: I’m a sophomore at Valwood School in South Georgia with a 4.33 GPA and the Highest GPA award for 2025–2026. I started AP classes as a freshman, and this year I’m taking AP World History and AP Biology.

Outside class I run ZR Photos, my own photography business. I’ve loved computers and drones for as long as I can remember, I work across Mac, Windows and Linux, and building FPV drones is next. I plan to study engineering.
